basic_details.job_title: IIT Bhilai Project Assistant (Mechanical Engineering) Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The TIH-IITB funded research project at Indian Institute of Technology, Bhilai (Durg district, Chhattisgarh) has one Project Assistant post for a duration of 1 year, with pay of 28,000 to 41,000. Indian nationals with a graduate degree in Banking Management or a related field and at least 1 year of work experience may apply. The application form and a detailed CV must be emailed to [email protected], with [email protected] in CC, on or before 13 November 2026, 5:30 PM. The interview is on 17 November 2026 at 10 am.

age_limit.details: Upper age limit: 35 years. The notice prints no age cut-off date and lists no age relaxation. | Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of the post.

how_to_apply: Take the application form attached with the notice (Annexure-III, "Application Form Project Assistant position in a TIH-IITB at IIT Bhilai").
Fill in the personal details: name, date of birth, gender, marital status, category (Gen/SC/ST/OBC), nationality, mailing address, permanent address, mobile/phone number and email.

Fill in the education details starting from matriculation, the qualifying examinations (CSIR/NET/GATE/Others) and the professional experience (research, industrial, teaching or others). Research publications, awards, patents, prizes and any other relevant information are also asked for in the form.
Sign the declaration at the end of the form, with place and date.
Email the duly filled form with a detailed CV to [email protected], with the Principal Investigator at [email protected] in CC.
Send the email on or before 13 November 2026, 5:30 PM.
The notice does not give a subject line for the email.
important_instructions: No TA/DA will be provided to the candidate for the interview. The selected candidate will have to join duty immediately on receipt of the offer. The Principal Investigator's email, [email protected], must be in CC on the application email. The declaration in the application form states that the institute may expel the applicant at any time after admission if the particulars furnished prove false or the antecedents show that continuance is not desirable.

The appointment is governed by the terms and conditions of the Institute/funding agency particularly applicable to the project, as and when required.

faq.question: Q1. How many Project Assistant posts has IIT Bhilai announced?
faq.answer: IIT Bhilai has announced 1 Project Assistant position in a TIH-IITB funded research project.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Bhilai Project Assistant post?

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for the IIT Bhilai Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: A Graduate Degree in Banking Management or a related field is required, with a minimum of 1 year of work experience and at least 2 months of experience at a NIT/IIT/CFTIs.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the IIT Bhilai Project Assistant post?

faq.question: Q5. What is the pay of the IIT Bhilai Project Assistant?

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for the IIT Bhilai Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: Email the duly filled application form and a detailed CV to [email protected], with [email protected] in CC, on or before 13 November 2026, 5:30 PM.

faq.question: Q7. How is the Project Assistant selected?
faq.answer: Selection is by interview, and the mode of the selection process is offline. The selection committee may restrict the number of candidates called for the interview, and its decision is final.
